name: agent-os-dev
description: Agent OS development: shape plans, deliver against ground truth, review independently, and guard delivery with hooks. Requires agent-os-core.

interface.shortDescription: Delivery, review, and guard hooks for code
interface.longDescription: Shapes a spec into delivery units in plan.md, delivers one unit at a time against ground truth with draft pull requests, runs batches through isolated workers, reviews candidates independently in a session or in CI against REVIEW.md, reproduces bugs before fixing, keeps touched code no worse, and enforces it with hooks for spec freeze, test locks, protected paths, secret scans, and a delivery Stop gate. Requires agent-os-core.
